abstracts.abstract: Regulates the sale of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles; requires sellers of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles to post a certain notice; prohibits deceptive marketing practices with regard to E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles.

bill.title: Regulates the sale and marketing of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles

posted_text:
🛣️ NY S10700 — New York Says: No Selling E-Motos on the Road

New York is stepping up to regulate the sale and marketing of electric off-highway motorcycles – nicknamed ‘E-motos’ – and electric off-highway motorcycles.

Starting now, only authorized ATV dealers physically located in New York can sell these vehicles, and online retailers are banned from selling them within the state.

If you try to buy an E-moto or electric off-highway motorcycle from an online retailer in New York, or if a dealer tries to sell you one without registering it with the DMV, you could face a fine.

Dealers must also post a clear warning about the legal restrictions on riding these vehicles on public roads.

The state can also fine anyone found to be making false or misleading claims about these vehicles, with penalties up to $1,000 for each violation.

Sept. 14, 2026: Referred to Rules.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/bills/2025/S10700
